correctness.rationale: Proof establishes genus 6 via 8 branch points and Riemann–Hurwitz, identifies a complete six-form differential basis by valuations, derives the characteristic-two Cartier block matrix, proves its 4x2 component has rank two using squarefreeness, and computes the iterated semilinear ranks. For the rank-one 2x2 matrix H, the fourth-iterate obstruction is H^[4] H with scalar sqrt(a3)+(sqrt(a6))^4. Its zero locus is exactly a3=a6^4 and a2=a6^5. All rank and geometry statements follow. Separate exact-arithmetic finite checks of 12,288 smooth F4 septics and 898 F8 cases agree. Finite checks are not used as a proof of infinite claims.

originality.rationale: The novel scope is the complete explicit 2-rank stratification, smooth coefficient geometry, and ranks of every Cartier iterate for characteristic-two genus-six (3,7) curves. Elkin already gives the general single-iterate Cartier algorithm and invariant first rank; those are excluded from novelty. England studies the same (3,7) polynomial in complex-analytic abelian-function theory. Özman–Pries–Weir study general p-rank strata but §6 assumes p odd, so their (2,4) dimension statement does not determine the characteristic-two coefficient graph. value.rationale: The claim gives a complete three-level 2-rank classification in a natural genus-six trielliptic polynomial family, including a nonempty smooth irreducible codimension-two vanishing locus with exact polynomial equations and an entire hierarchy of Cartier iterate ranks. This distinguishes intrinsic Jacobian invariants across a branch-type-constant family with a-number always 2. It directly informs the geometry of small-characteristic trielliptic p-rank strata, rather than being a scalar computation or arbitrary slice.
